title: Fix dashboard accuracy + reporting issues
description:
Scope: static dashboard under dashboard/ + JSON exporters under src/analysis/.

Goals:
- Remove bogus taxa rows (e.g., genus 'nan'/'None') from explorer, survivor tables, and dino stats.
- Correct null-model p-value reporting (avoid p=0), seed randomness, and clarify what is shuffled.
- Reduce ML evaluation leakage (avoid same-genus overlap), add confusion matrix, and soften UI emphasis.
- Clarify binning (5 Ma bins) and modularity limitations (resolution limit / sampling bias).
- Improve asset loading (remove Date.now cache-bust; lazy-load heavy explorer data).

Risks:
- Numbers on the site will change after cleaning (expected); ensure copy explains changes.
- Regenerating dashboard JSONs requires local deps (pandas/sklearn).

Validation:
- Rebuild dashboard JSONs via src.cli analyze --type dashboard.
- Smoke-load dashboard/index.html locally (basic JS console check).
close_reason: Implemented data cleaning (remove nan/None taxa), fixed null-model p-value + seeding, improved ML holdout (grouped by genus) + confusion matrix, added context copy, removed per-load cache-busting, split heavy explorer data into lazy-loaded explorer_data.json, regenerated dashboard JSONs.

title: Research folder cleanup: dedup + archive + public-ready docs
description:
Goal: make the `thesis/` research workspace readable and public-friendly.

Tasks:
- Deduplicate identical large blobs safely (no information loss).
- Move superseded/local runs into `thesis/_archive/` (kept locally; not tracked).
- Label upstream artifacts and provenance clearly.
- Keep literature lists in one global place (not per-run).
- Remove degree-specific framing; present this as a research project.
- Maintain minimal public entrypoints (root `README.md`, `thesis/README.md`) and curated figures.
- Keep large/generated artifacts out of git via `.gitignore`.
close_reason: Public-readiness cleanup: removed owner email from beads export, reorganized thesis writeups, added navigation docs, and stopped tracking generated output figures.
